text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from answering emails to organising data, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees plan their schedules, write reports and make better decisions. However, AI does not replace people completely. The best results come from human-AI collaboration, where workers use smart tools while adding their own creativity and judgement. This shift is also changing jobs. Some roles may disappear, but new ones are appearing, and many existing jobs now require digital skills. For these reasons, learning to work alongside AI is becoming an important skill for everyone.
